question: In this video clip, how is the character's location moving in the 3D scene relative to his/her/its starting orientation and location?

final_answer.text: C: Moving backward and turning right. Projected onto the character's own measured facing axis, the displacement was -0.628 along the axis (backward) and 0.086 lateral (to the right) (math_1).
final_answer.limitations: Facing axis derived from two grounded torso points in frame 0 and assumed constant; if the character turned during the clip the projection uses only the starting orientation.
